title: Paw Print Pathway
description: A surreal painted scene features a large black paw print centered on a bold red and green geometric background. A winding yellow path leads through a vibrant foreground filled with stylized flowers, purple lilacs, and swirling foliage under a starry sky.
prompt: Surreal painted artwork showing a large black animal paw print centered on a red geometric panel with green chevron borders. A bright yellow winding path flows from the bottom toward the center, surrounded by dense stylized flowers including purple lilacs, pink and white blooms, and swirling green foliage. The background transitions from dark starry space on the sides to warm earthy tones, creating a vibrant and dreamlike composition.
